answer_1.quote: we propose a novel generative multi-stage EG construction method, called Typed Predicate-Entailment Graph Generator (TP-EGG).
answer_1.outputs: typed entailment graphs containing predicates and their entailment relations

answer_2.quote: we evaluate TP-EGG on the test datasets by calculating the area under the curves (AUC) of Precision-Recall Curve (PRC) for precision>0.5 and traditional ROC curve.

answer_4.quote: The re-annotation results are confirmed by the majority voting of annotators, and may still contain natural errors.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators receive a competitive pay of about 100 yuan per hour under the agreement of the institute, which is more than 4 times the local minimum wage. The annotation complies with the ACL Code of Ethics.
